title: stream-lifecycle-ungraceful-terminate-reconnect-backoff-openai-adapter
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: client-side ungraceful disconnects (network flaps, browser tab kills, proxy resets) were causing partial-stream state to be dropped and tool/function-call side effects to be replayed or lost when clients reconnected. This PR implements a conservative lifecycle policy and an OpenAI-compat adapter for safer reconnect/resume semantics. Key ideas: 1) Deferred termination window (configurable grace period) where server retains ephemeral session state and outgoing event cache; 2) Idempotent stream tokens + sequence checkpoint published in final events to allow client resume without duplication; 3) Exponential reconnect backoff guidance surfaced via headers and adapter behavior; 4) Safe tool/function-call dedup marked by call-instance id and pre-commit acknowledgement; 5) Server-side fast-fail on stale resume attempts. This change touches runtime stream orchestration, the openai-compat shim, and a small addition to the client-visible headers. Checklist: - [x] implement deferred termination + retention cleanup - [x] add resume token and sequence metadata to streaming protocol - [x] add call-instance id plumbing for tool calls - [x] expose reconnect-backoff hints via X-Redwood-Retry header - [x] unit and integration tests for resume + duplicate suppression - [x] update docs and changelog. This description intentionally combines context and implementation notes in a single continuous string per repo convention.
commits: a1b8f3c: implement deferred session retention and eviction timer (runtime/stream/session.go)
b3d27c1: emit resume_token and seq_id in final stream event (openai/adapter/streaming.go)
c9f4e6a: add call-instance-id header parsing and tool-call dedup table (runtime/handler/tool_calls.go)
d2a4b5f: add X-Redwood-Retry header and backoff suggestions (api/middleware/headers.go)
e6f0b22: tests: resume path, duplicate tool-call suppression, and eviction behavior (tests/stream_resume_test.go)
diff_snippet:
--- a/openai/adapter/streaming.go
+++ b/openai/adapter/streaming.go
@@ -142,6 +142,14 @@ func writeFinalEvent(w io.Writer, ev Event) error {
     ev.Type = "done"
     ev.Payload = summary

+    // attach resume metadata so clients can attempt safe resume
+    ev.Metadata["resume_token"] = session.ResumeToken
+    ev.Metadata["seq_id"] = strconv.FormatInt(session.LastSeq, 10)
+
+    // hint for client backoff behaviour
+    w.Header().Set("X-Redwood-Retry", "min=200ms,max=30s,algorithm=exponential")
+
     return json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(ev)
 }
review_comments: Miguel Torres (2026-02-22): Nice isolation of the retention timer. Question: what happens if the tool-call had external side effects and the client never reconnects within the window? Should we make the call pre-commit optional?

Asha Patel (2026-02-23): We mark tool-calls with a call-instance-id and a pre-commit flag. By default pre-commit=false for potentially side-effecting calls; operator can opt-in. Added tests to cover post-window cleanup (deleted dedup entry and recorded as orphaned).
Rebecca Lin (2026-02-24): CI flaked on the integration test (sporadic fd leak). Please ensure the session eviction goroutine is bounded and context-cancel safe.
Asha Patel (2026-02-25): Addressed: eviction goroutine now uses time.AfterFunc with explicit cancel and test uses a test clock to avoid flakiness. Re-ran CI (see checks).
Samir Dutta (2026-02-27): Approve after small nits in doc wording. Consider a follow-up for telemetry counters for resume attempts.
release_notes: Add server-side deferred termination window and resume-token support for streaming API. Improves safety for ungraceful client disconnects and reduces duplicate tool/function-call effects on reconnect. Exposes X-Redwood-Retry header to convey backoff guidance to clients.
notes_on_testing: Added deterministic tests using a test clock for eviction timing and a mocked upstream for tool-call dedup verification. Integration tests exercise browser-like reconnect (short disconnect + resume) and long disconnect eviction path.
docs_changes_summary: docs/streaming/reconnect.md documents the new resume_token flow, recommended client backoff, and guidance on pre-commit tool-calls. Examples include a TypeScript reconnect client and notes for OpenAI-compatible consumers.
